method: Every decimal number (and every integer above 20) in the scoped documents is matched to a numeric leaf of a committed result file that rounds to the printed value at the printed precision, or to a listed derivation or design parameter. Matching by value is necessary but not sufficient; the claims audit records the manual check that each match is the intended quantity for the primary and claim-bearing numbers.
